verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an LLM gateway and observability platform, for example batch inference or bulk actions on logs, keys or configs. The evidence pack documents no such capability. Filtering logs by Config ID, load balancing and org-wide budget controls are adjacent features, not bulk operations a user performs across many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
